codes.signedOut: You're signed out. Sign in again to continue.
codes.sessionExpired: Your session expired: you're signed out. Sign in again to continue.
codes.loginTimeout: Sign-in wasn't finished within {minutes} minutes, so it was cancelled. Try again.
codes.noBrowser: No browser opened for sign-in. Set a default web browser for this account and try again.
codes.alreadyInProgress: Another operation on this lab is already in progress; wait for it to finish.
codes.noPasswordStored: No password is stored for this host. Edit it and enter one.
codes.portInUse: Host port {port} is already in use on this machine (another lab or app holds it). Stop whatever uses it, or start the lab with random ports.
codes.dockerNotRunning: Docker isn't running. Start your container engine (Docker Desktop, or the docker service on Linux), then start the lab again.
codes.dockerDenied: Docker is running, but your account can't use it yet. Add yourself to the docker group in a terminal (sudo usermod -aG docker {user}), then log out and back in.
codes.dockerDeniedWindows: Docker is running, but your account can't use it yet. Add yourself to the docker-users group (in a terminal run as administrator: net localgroup docker-users "{user}" /add), then sign out and back in.
codes.toolMissing: `{tool}` is not installed or not on PATH
codes.unreachable: Cyber CTF can't be reached ({detail}). Check your connection and try again.
codes.offlineReady: Cyber CTF can't be reached ({detail}). This lab is installed here, so it can start offline, without saving progress.

placementLockedHost.one: {count} lab is still on this host: stop it before changing its {fields}.
placementLockedHost.other: {count} labs are still on this host: stop them before changing its {fields}.

placementLockedAccount.one: {count} lab is still on this account: stop it before changing its {fields}.
placementLockedAccount.other: {count} labs are still on this account: stop them before changing its {fields}.

hostHasLabs.one: {count} lab still running on this host. Stop it before removing the host.
hostHasLabs.other: {count} labs still running on this host. Stop them before removing the host.

codes.reapNoHost: No account is recorded for it, so the launcher can't destroy it. Remove its resources in your cloud console.
codes.reapLabGone: Its lab files are gone ({detail}). Install the lab again, then stop it, or remove its resources in your cloud console.
codes.reapAccount: The account {account} can't be used ({detail}). Fix the account in Settings, then stop the lab.
codes.reapTimedOut: The destroy didn't finish within {minutes} minutes. Stop the lab to retry.
